# measurement method

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:measurementMethod`](gmeow-measurementMethod.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/measurementMethod>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The dating method used for a temporal measurement. Bridges to [`gmeow:observationMethod`](gmeow-observationMethod.md) ([rdfs:subPropertyOf](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subPropertyOf)) so generic consumers can query all observations by method without knowing the domain.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:TemporalMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalMeasurement.md) -> [`gmeow:DatingMethod`](../classes/gmeow-DatingMethod.md); functional
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:observationMethod`](gmeow-observationMethod.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:measurementMethod`](gmeow-measurementMethod.md) from [`gmeow:TemporalMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalMeasurement.md) to [`gmeow:DatingMethod`](../classes/gmeow-DatingMethod.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:observationMethod`](gmeow-observationMethod.md), [`gmeow:TemporalMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalMeasurement.md), [`gmeow:DatingMethod`](../classes/gmeow-DatingMethod.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record which [`gmeow:DatingMethod`](../classes/gmeow-DatingMethod.md) produced a [`gmeow:TemporalMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalMeasurement.md) — the technique behind the age, queryable through the [`gmeow:observationMethod`](gmeow-observationMethod.md) bridge.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting two methods on one measurement (functional — exactly one) and avoid using a free-text method name; reference a seeded [`gmeow:DatingMethod`](../classes/gmeow-DatingMethod.md) individual.

### How to use

- Set one [`gmeow:DatingMethod`](../classes/gmeow-DatingMethod.md) individual; the [rdfs:subPropertyOf](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subPropertyOf) [`gmeow:observationMethod`](gmeow-observationMethod.md) bridge lets domain-neutral consumers query every observation by method without knowing it is a dating method.

### Examples

- ex:charcoalDate [`gmeow:measurementMethod`](gmeow-measurementMethod.md) [`gmeow:datingMethodRadiocarbon`](../individuals/gmeow-datingMethodRadiocarbon.md).
